title: Phnom Penh electronics
sub: Phone, gadget and repair markets, each with time from Baitong Hotel (BKK1), Nov 2026
tip: Markets close early: Russian Market ~5pm (arrive by 3:30), Central and Orussey ~6pm (arrive by 4:30). Sorya (~9pm) and AEON (~10pm) are open into the evening and air-conditioned. Catching a bus? The Sorya bus station is 2 min from Central Market, which opens about 7am (phone stalls a bit later). Haggle, and test anything before you pay. Hours are from travel guides, so check Google Maps on the day.

places.name: Orussey Market
notes: Cheapest phones, chargers and accessories, mostly locals
The streets around it (St 182 and Monivong) are lined with phone and laptop shops

places.name: Central Market (Phsar Thmei)
notes: Phone, watch and camera stalls under the art-deco dome
Easiest for visitors and worth seeing anyway

places.name: Sorya Center Point
notes: Air-conditioned mall with floors of phone and gadget stalls
Two minutes from Central Market, so do both together

places.name: Russian Market (Toul Tom Poung)
notes: Best for same-day repairs, spare parts and second-hand phones

places.name: AEON Mall 1
notes: Proper electronics shops, fixed prices, real warranty
Go here if you want something new and genuine

places.name: Phnom Penh Sorya bus station
notes: Main Sorya bus station, 2 min walk from Central Market
Mekong Express and Capitol Tours also pick up around Central Market. Check your ticket, Giant Ibis leaves from its own office
